foreignQualification.feeBasis: Flat filing fee of $250.00 for the Application for Certificate of Authority (Form L-09); annual reports and certified copies carry separate fees.
foreignQualification.formName: Application for Certificate of Authority (Form L-09)
foreignQualification.filedWith: North Carolina Department of the Secretary of State, Business Registration Division
foreignQualification.ongoingObligationsNote: File an annual report by April 15 of each year after the year of creation and maintain a registered agent in North Carolina.

evidence.quote: Limited Liability Company (LLC) Application for Certificate of Authority L-09(PDF) $250.00

the business entity must complete and submit one executed original application for a Certificate of Authority, specific to its entity type, to the North Carolina Department of the Secretary of State Business Registration Division.
Instructions for Filing APPLICATION FOR CERTIFICATE OF AUTHORITY FOR A LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANY (Form L-09)
Enter the name of the registered agent. The registered agent must be a North Carolina resident
Your report is due on April 15th of each year after the year of creation.
The Application must include a Certificate of Existence (or similar document) not more than 6 month from the home jurisdiction.

notes: The $250 fee is the registration fee only; annual reports carry their own fee (online $203, paper $200 per the due-dates page) and the figure lives in the root states.json. A Certificate of Existence from the home jurisdiction, not more than six months old, must accompany the application.
